description: The dated, source-cited log of what changed across IBM Maximo / MAS 9.x (9.1 onward): deprecations, behaviour changes, API/fixes, security, gotchas, upgrades, lifecycle and releases. Only real change records (never data-dictionary noise) and nothing the curator demoted. Same data as assetize.com.au/changelog. Optionally filter by version ("9.1", "9.2") and/or type.

type.description: Filter to one change type: DEPRECATION, BEHAVIOUR_CHANGE, FIX, SECURITY, GOTCHA, UPGRADE, LIFECYCLE, RELEASE.

version.description: Filter to a 9.x line, e.g. "9.2". Omit for all of 9.x.

name: maximo_changelog
title: Maximo 9.x change log
